episodes.synopsis: If young Noor wants to leave his simple farm life and become an adventurer, he's going to need to learn some skills!
episodes.title: I Parry a Cow

episodes.synopsis: After Noor takes out a vicious demon, the likes of which folks have never seen, he is reluctant to take credit. However, Lynne, the girl Noor saved, seeks him out.
episodes.title: I Parry the Reward

episodes.synopsis: Noor may be exhausted, but he never gives up. When Gilbert invites him for a mock battle, Noor simply can’t resist the practice for a budding adventurer like himself.
episodes.title: I Parry Taking On A Page

episodes.synopsis: The more Noor tries to clear up an understanding, the more complicated the situation gets! Meanwhile, Rein plots to use Noor as a future secret weapon.
episodes.title: I Parry a Goblin

episodes.synopsis: Noor and Rein encounter a vicious monster and a mysterious boy that appear in the royal capital of Crays Kingdom.
episodes.title: I Parry a Frog

episodes.synopsis: The boy that Noor saved was born a "demon" with the power to control monsters. Noor sees past that and recognizes his talents, but another threat lurks around the corner.
episodes.title: I Parry Deadly Poison

episodes.synopsis: A dead man who was once an S-rank adventurer has become a vicious murderer. Meanwhile, a threat on a scale beyond human comprehension appears in the sky above the capital.
episodes.title: I Parry the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Noor steps in to face the dragon that appears over the royal capital. A fierce battle unfolds; it’s time to parry every attack!
episodes.title: I Parry the Dragon

episodes.synopsis: The army of a foreign empire, which signed a non-aggression pact with the Crays Kingdom, finally begins its invasion. Standing in its way: Noor!
episodes.title: I Parry an Army

episodes.synopsis: Noor and his team take on a battle that will decide the future of the Crays Kingdom.
episodes.title: I Parry the Emperor's Authority

episodes.synopsis: Noor must use all his strength to parry his toughest challenge yet: a beam of magical light!
episodes.title: I Parry Divine Wrath

episodes.synopsis: After the battle for Crays Kingdom is over, Noor is busy cleaning away the debris. Amid the rubble, he finds something that makes his childhood days come back to him.
episodes.title: I Parry Everything
